env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
mkdir $WORK/bin

cd ao
logos build ./g
! logos build -o $WORK/bin/negas$GOEXE ./negas
stderr 'const_view_mutation'
! logos build -o $WORK/bin/neggrab$GOEXE ./neggrab
stderr 'const_view_mutation'
logos build -o $WORK/bin/pos$GOEXE ./pos
exec $WORK/bin/pos$GOEXE
stdout '^assert-only-ok$'
cd ..

-- ao/go.mod --
module example.com/ao

go 1.27

-- ao/g/g.go --
package g

func As[T any](x any) T {
	return x.(T)
}

type Slot struct{}

func (Slot) Grab[T any](x any) T {
	return x.(T)
}

-- ao/negas/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"example.com/ao/g"
)

func main() {
	var cv const []int = []int{1, 2, 3}
	_ = g.As[[]int](cv)
}

-- ao/neggrab/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"example.com/ao/g"
)

func main() {
	var cv const []int = []int{1, 2, 3}
	s := g.Slot{}
	_ = s.Grab[[]int](cv)
}

-- ao/pos/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/ao/g"
)

func main() {
	if got := g.As[[]int]([]int{1, 2, 3}); len(got) != 3 {
		fmt.Println("as-bad")
		return
	}
	s := g.Slot{}
	if got := s.Grab[[]int]([]int{4, 5}); len(got) != 2 {
		fmt.Println("grab-bad")
		return
	}
	fmt.Println("assert-only-ok")
}
